Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 2

“The Blessed Lord said: Both renunciation and the yoga of action lead to the highest good. But of the two, the yoga of action surpasses the renunciation of action.”

Krishna finally ranks them, and picks the harder-sounding option. Both work, but the one that keeps a person in the world is the one he recommends to Arjuna.
